newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Strike halts operations at Kuwait Airways.
newsitem.headline: Strike halts operations at Kuwait Airways.

text.p: Kuwait Airways Corp pilots and engineers began the first of a series of planned one-day strikes on Tuesday, halting all operations by the national carrier from the Gulf Arab state.
The strike started at 0700 a.m. (0400 GMT), a Kuwait Airways official said.

Kuwait Aircraft Engineers and Pilots Association agreed late on Monday night to bring Kuwait Airways to a complete halt every Tuesday starting this week. Their strike plans also include delaying all outbound flights by one hour during the week.
"The industrial action will affect Kuwait Airways only," the association said in a statement issued early on Tuesday.

It said the strike was agreed on due to "failure of negotiations and prolonged deliberations by government committees which have lasted for more than a year without reaching acceptable settlement...".
The association in November agreed to postpone industrial action after talks with the country's crown prince and prime minister, Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah.
It is demanding "adjustment of salaries, allowances and restoration of certain benefits".
